en.installDoneOtherVersion: Under pnpm's supply-chain security policy (minimumReleaseAge), versions published more recently than the required age are not installed automatically, so this installation used {installed} instead of the latest version {version}. A newly published version has not completed this waiting period and may contain undetected malicious code or defects. If you need {version}, uninstall the current version and then install {exact} to request that version.
